description: Get the live onboarding page (https://slickfast.com/start) for a new user: what SlickFast does, the three ways to use it (local MCP, hosted MCP, HTTP API), and when a free API key is needed (only for public URLs and sharing). No key needed. Use on first connect, when the user is new, or when the "Get started" prompt is used. After this, call news (current, not the archive), then gallery, then try one small render_chart. For scientific charts, call describe_type({ type: "volcano" }) first. Do not paste the page's HTML.
name: get_started
title: Get started with SlickFast — onboarding Page
